purpose: Convert the asset dream queue into a concrete asset-family inspection queue for Studio/lab passes.

queuePolicy.unitOfWork: one asset family at a time
queuePolicy.firstGate: clean-spot clone screenshots: front, back, left, right, overhead, player-height
queuePolicy.secondGate: same family seen in at least one live in-world player-height placement
queuePolicy.propagationRule: fixing a temp clone is not enough; apply canonical up/forward/scale/grounding to every live clone or explicitly skip non-visual helpers
queuePolicy.releaseRule: search metadata and bounding boxes are not release proof; palette commit waits for inspection plus player-angle screenshot evidence

items.whyFirst: Best known fern seed in the local brain; score/votes are stronger than the other fern records and it is script-free.
items.nextAction: Studio asset family sweep; accept only if fronds are upright and grounded from player height.

items.problem: need fallback if Fern Bush scale/orientation fails
items.whyFirst: Strong secondary fern seed and script-free; spelling in catalog name is preserved as source data.
items.nextAction: Inspect after Q001 or sooner if the live world already uses this family.

items.problem: need varied ground-cover pack if individual ferns look repetitive
items.whyFirst: Script-free plant pack seed; useful if it can produce upright food/ground-cover subfamilies.
items.nextAction: Inspect only as a pack and split winners into separate asset-family records before placement.

items.whyFirst: Highest-value dinosaur pack seed; could cover multiple player/NPC species if orientation and rig evidence pass.
missingEvidence: canonical up/forward for each chosen species
items.nextAction: Inspect as a pack; do not place broadly until each selected species family has its own orientation record.

items.problem: predator needs readable forward direction and script quarantine
items.whyFirst: Strong raptor visual seed but scripted; useful only after script review and orientation proof.
items.nextAction: Quarantine scripts before visual evaluation; reject if behavior cannot be separated from art.

items.problem: hatchling needs small readable body orientation
items.whyFirst: Script-free hatchling seed for Beat 0; lower risk than scripted raptor candidates.
items.nextAction: Inspect after the main dino pack, or earlier if current world hatchling is the source of face-down visuals.

items.problem: nest needs readable non-placeholder Beat 0 visual
items.whyFirst: Theropod nest is more on-theme for starter dinosaur hatching than generic egg/faberge assets.
items.nextAction: Inspect after visible fern/dino blockers unless current world nest is already placed wrong.

items.problem: carnivore food needs edible visual clarity
items.whyFirst: Only current animal carcass-like seed with no scripts; may be too small/off-theme but deserves a quick scale check.
items.nextAction: Inspect as a possible small-carcass food; reject if it reads as tiny clutter.

items.problem: need fallback bone/carrion dressing if carcass search remains weak
items.whyFirst: Strong rated bone pack seed; likely useful as dressing or fallback food cue after scale/subasset split.
missingEvidence: pack split into edible vs decorative families
items.nextAction: Inspect as a pack; do not call it edible meat unless screenshots prove food readability.

items.problem: swamp water props need water-plane grounding
items.whyFirst: Direct lily pad seed; orientation and waterline fit are the main questions.
items.nextAction: Inspect after primary fern/dino blockers or when Swamp Delta pass begins.

items.problem: route-framing rocks must not block camera or traversal
items.whyFirst: Simple script-free rock seed from project manifest; good candidate for canonical grounding/scale pass.
items.nextAction: Inspect during Redstone Canyon family pass.

items.problem: city ruins have high script risk; start with script-free core pieces
